```{r}
#| label: list_data_processed
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

library(fs)
library(readr)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)

list_path <- "data_p"
list_pattern <- "[.](?:xls(?:x)?|csv|rds(?:[.]gz)?)$"
desc_file <- "data_p.csv"

file_p <- dir_info(path = list_path, regexp = list_pattern,
                   type = "file", recurse = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

desc_p <- read_csv(desc_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

full_join(file_p, desc_p, by = "path") |>
  mutate(파일명 = path_file(path),
    설명 = description,
    수정일 = format(modification_time, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    다운로드 = ifelse(file_exists(path),
                  paste0("<a href=\"", path, "\" download>", path, "</a>"),
                  path)
  ) |>
  select(파일명:다운로드) |>
  arrange(desc(수정일), 파일명) |>
  knitr::kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: list_data_dt
#| echo: false
library(fs)
library(readr)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)

list_path <- "data"
list_pattern <- "[.](?:xls(?:x)?|csv|rds(?:[.]gz)?)$"
desc_file <- "file_description.csv"

file_list <- dir_info(path = list_path, regexp = list_pattern,
                   type = "file", recurse = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

file_desc <- read_csv(desc_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

left_join(file_list, file_desc, by = "path") |>
  mutate(파일명 = path_file(path),
    설명 = description,
    수정일 = format(modification_time, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    다운로드 = ifelse(file_exists(path),
                  paste0("<a href=\"", path, "\" download>", path, "</a>"),
                  path)
  ) |>
  select(파일명:다운로드) |>
  DT::datatable(escape = FALSE)
```
